description: Find Nas House articles by keywords (for example "day pass price", "garden event capacity", "check-in time"). Returns up to `limit` matching articles with slug, summary, topic, tags, dates and URLs, best match first. Start here; then call get_article with a slug to read one in full.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1 to 20. Default 5.

query.description: Keywords or a short question, for example "how many guests can stay overnight".

tag.description: Optional tag slug to restrict results, as returned by list_tags (for example "events").

topic.description: Optional topic slug to restrict results, as returned by list_topics.

name: search_articles

slug.description: Article slug; pass it to get_article.

tags.description: Tag names, as written in the article.

title: Search Nas House articles
